assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and supraventricular tachycardia.
The diagnosis codes I48.91 and I47.1 are associated with the patient's condition.
A 48-hour Holter monitor is ordered to correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and guide further management.
The CPT code for the 48-hour Holter monitor is 93226.
The service is medically necessary to directly address the documented clinical presentation.
